tagline: Rugby in the heart of the Swansea Valley since 1881
short: Pontardawe RFC is a community rugby union club in Pontardawe, in the Swansea Valley, Wales. Founded in 1881, it is a member club of the Welsh Rugby Union with a clubhouse, bar and members' club on Ynysderw Road.
league_note: Wikipedia lists the club in WRU Division 4 West Central, finishing 2nd in 2022-23. League names change from season to season; the WRU site has the current table and fixtures.
history: Pontardawe Rugby Football Club was founded in 1881 in Pontardawe, a small town on the River Tawe in the Swansea Valley. It is one of the long-standing member clubs of the Welsh Rugby Union, and in 2007 it celebrated its 125th year of WRU membership.

Over the years Pontardawe has produced a number of first-class players and coaches. The club's junior section has provided age-group rugby with qualified coaches from under 7 through to under 16, and many other clubs, premiership sides included, have benefited from players who learned the game at Pontardawe.

In May 2006 Pontardawe was one of the thirteen 'rebel' clubs that brought a vote of no confidence in the Welsh Rugby Union over its finances and the departure of national coach Mike Ruddock. The motion failed, but it showed a club willing to stand up for the community game.
Like many clubs, Pontardawe has sold vintage rugby memorabilia to raise money to improve its facilities. A history of the club, The History of Pontardawe RFC by J. R. Jones, was published in 1985.

faq.a: The clubhouse is on Ynysderw Road, Pontardawe, Neath Port Talbot, SA8 4EG. Home games are at the Recreation Ground in Pontardawe.

faq.q: What is the club's phone number?

faq.a: Pontardawe RFC was founded in 1881, and celebrated 125 years as a Welsh Rugby Union member club in 2007.

faq.q: How do I become a member?
faq.a: Ask behind the bar or call 01792 864811. Once the club has added you, sign in to the members' app at member.pontardawerfc.com with your email address and the code we send.

faq.q: How do I use my members' discount?
faq.a: Open the members' app at member.pontardawerfc.com and show your card's code at the bar. The discount is applied at the till.
Yes. On the Menu & Order page you can order to your table when you are in the clubhouse, or order for collection and pay at the bar when you collect.

faq.q: How do I pay for a collection order?
faq.a: Collection orders are paid at the bar when you collect them, by card or cash.

faq.q: Where are the fixtures and results?
faq.a: The current fixtures, results and league table are on the WRU community site, and the club posts match news on its Facebook page.

faq.q: Can I hire the clubhouse for a function?
faq.a: Yes, the clubhouse hosts parties, celebrations and wakes. Call the club on 01792 864811 to check dates and prices.

faq.q: Does the club have junior rugby?
faq.a: The club has a history of age-group rugby from under 7 to under 16 with qualified coaches. Call the club to find out which age groups are training this season.

faq.q: Can my business sponsor the club?
faq.a: Yes, the club welcomes sponsors. Call the club on 01792 864811 to talk about kit, match-day and pitch-side sponsorship.
Wikipedia lists Nathan Jones and Rhys Morgan as the club's coaches.

faq.q: Which famous players came from Pontardawe?
faq.a: Wales internationals James Griffiths, Phil Hopkins, Percy Lloyd and Joe Hawkins all played for Pontardawe.
